flagged.title: The Skeleton: Functions and Structure
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly tells students that the Edexcel specification specifically requires five bone shape categories rather than four, which would cause students to lose marks on specification-based classification questions.

mark_affecting.quote: Edexcel specifically groups bones into five distinct shapes... unlike some other exam boards, you know, some only teach four categories, Edexcel specifically requires you to know this unique fifth category for your exams.

flagged.title: Planes and Axes of Movement
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims a swimmer's tumble turn occurs in the frontal plane around the sagittal axis (like a cartwheel), which would lose marks on a GCSE PE exam because it is a forward somersault in the sagittal plane around the frontal axis.

mark_affecting.quote: A swimmer's tumble turn actually works exactly the same way.
